{{Quote|Of course I would want my son to follow in my footsteps. Nothing would make me more proud. Answering the call to service is a noble endeavor.|TK 329, regarding Gareth|<ref name="Storm" />}}
'''Gareth'''<ref name="ItsABoy" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Logic" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]], the son of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TK 329]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Mera]].<ref name="ItsABoy" /> TK 329 wanted Gareth to join the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] when they grew up, and he believed that his wife and son supported him and his mission. Shortly before his [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="Storm" /> aboard the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]<ref name="ItsABoy" /> after being exposed to the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]]<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]'' places the ''Vector'' outbreak in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> TK 329 broadcast an open transmission telling Gareth to take care of Mera in his absence. The stormtrooper also mentioned that he was planning a big party for his next visit home and the he had purchased something special for Gareth.<ref name="Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gareth was mentioned in five [[Wikipedia:Twitter|tweets]] from TK 329's [[in-universe]] [[Stormtrooper TK 329 (TK329) on Twitter|Twitter account]]. The account was created in [[2009]]<ref name="Storm" /> as a tie-in to the then-upcoming novel ''[[Death Troopers]]'', written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Death Troopers" />
